model.empirical: a_emp = (C_T cos u + S_T sin u) T + (C_N cos u + S_N sin u) N, u = argument of latitude in J2000, T = N x R, N = h/|h|; 4 parameters, constant over the arc, prior N(0, 1e-8 m/s^2) each
model.implementation: study-level (frozen dynamics.py unchanged): production propagate_state's own RHS via dynamics._build_state_rhs plus a_emp, integrated with dynamics._shadow_contact_times / _integrate_segmented (DOP853, rtol 1e-10)
model.rest: F2e/F2f unchanged: GL1800F N = 300, Earth/Sun DE440, cannonball SRP (K prior 0.010 +- 0.005), range + Doppler (A1 bound), range-bias priors, global Doppler bias, A1 FD sensitivities extended by 4 empirical columns (step 1e-9 m/s^2), parallel workers

starts: S1 = F2e's S1 (F2d solution); S2 = S1 + (100 m, 0.1 m/s) via F2f's arc continuation (one-day stage first)

gates.G0_equivalence: with the empirical parameters at zero, the study propagation equals production propagate_state(method DOP853, shadow_events True) bit for bit on the two-day grid (N = 300, F2d solution state)

gates.G2_start_independence: S1 and S2 agree to <= 1 m in position
